name: Company
observations: Owner: Aarav. Update this entity with what the company does, who it serves and what it sells
Voice: direct, friendly, plain words, no hype
Every deliverable waits in out/ or work/ for the owner's OK before it goes anywhere
Music rotates weekly (owner, 2026-10-19): the Music team replaces the tracks in music/ with fresh ones that match what viral videos use now; deleting last week's tracks there is allowed

name: Brand rules
observations: Edits are 45 seconds max; cut every pause longer than half a second
No filler words (um, uh) in the edit or the captions
Captions: 3 words per line, the spoken word highlighted in yellow #FFD400
Cover text: 3 words max, all caps, the last word in yellow #FFD400
Titles: under 60 characters, plain and specific, no clickbait
Copy: short sentences, one idea each, no exclamation marks, no buzzwords
Music: every edit gets a track from music/ at about 18% under the voice, ducked under speech, with a one-second fade in and out

Music choice: follow music/brief.md (what viral videos in the niche use right now); name tracks <mood>-<name>.mp3 and pass --mood to tools/music.py; keep edit.mp4 for adding a trending sound in the Instagram app
Reel style (from work/research/reel-style/trends.md, 2026-10-20): a swing reel is 4 to 10 seconds, starts at the takeaway with no standing around, ends on the finish
Reel style: slow motion only through the strike, 2x on a 60 fps phone clip, back to normal speed after impact; no frame interpolation, no flash, no shaky zoom
Reel style: keep the real strike sound loud and on the contact frame; music sits low under it (about 35%) and never covers it
Reel style: one short text line, big, plain bold, on the first second, at least 250 px from the top and bottom edges; last word yellow #FFD400
Reel style: vertical 9:16 with the golfer large in the frame; test down-the-line against face-on and keep the angle that gets more watch time and sends
